043package dev.visdb.seesaw;
044
045import java.awt.event.ItemEvent;
046import java.awt.event.ItemListener;
047import java.lang.System.Logger;
048import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
049import java.sql.JDBCType;
050import java.sql.SQLException;
051import java.util.EnumSet;
052import java.util.EventListener;
053
054import javax.swing.JCheckBox;
055import javax.swing.border.Border;
056
057import dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators.BorderDecorator;
058import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel;
059import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
060import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent;
061import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils;
062
063import static dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.ConvertType.assertConvertFromJdbcType;
064import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
065import static java.sql.JDBCType.*;
066
067/**
068 * Used to display values stored in the database as a boolean.
069 * The CheckBox can be bound to a numeric or boolean database column.
070 * The boolean value is converted to the data base type by the
071 * {@link #setColumnObject(java.lang.Object)} infrastructure.
072 * Currently, Dec 2024, if bound to a numeric database column, a checked
073 * SsCheckBox puts a '1' to the database and an unchecked SsCheckBox puts a '0'.
074 * <p>
075 * TODO: In the future an option may be added to allow the user to specify the
076 * values returned for the checked and unchecked SsCheckBox states.
077 */
078@SuppressWarnings("serial")
079public class SsCheckBox extends JCheckBox implements SsComponent {
080  /**
081   * Listener(s) for the component's value used to propagate changes back to bound
082   * database column
083   */
084  protected class CheckBoxListener implements ItemListener {
085    /** {@inheritDoc} */
086    @Override
087    public void itemStateChanged(ItemEvent ie) {
088      try {
089        dbChange(() -> setColumnObject(isSelected()));
090      } catch (SQLException ex) {
091        logger.log(Level.ERROR, (String) null, ex);
092      }
093    }
094  }
095
096  /** System Logger for component. */
097  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
098
099  /**
100   * Creates an object of CheckBox.
101   */
102  public SsCheckBox() {
103    this(null);
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Creates an object of CheckBox binding it to the specified column in the
108   * given RowSet.
109   *
110   * @param rowsModel        model for a rowSet
111   * @param columnName name of the column to which this check box should be
112   *                         bound
113   */
114  public SsCheckBox(RowsModel rowsModel, String columnName) {
115    this(null);
116    rowsModel.bind(this, columnName);
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Creates an object of CheckBox.
121   *
122   * @param text Checkbox label
123   */
124  public SsCheckBox(String text) {
125    super(text);
126    logger.log(Level.DEBUG,
127               () -> sf("original border: %s", BorderDecorator.asString(getBorder(), this)));
128    // JCheckBox disables painting the borders.
129    // Replace the JCheckBox border with an empty border.
130    Border b = BorderDecorator.createEmptyBorder(this);
131    setBorder(b);
132    setBorderPainted(true);
133    finishSsCommon();
134  }
135
136  /** {@inheritDoc } */
137  @Override
138  public void checkColumnType(JDBCType jdbcType) throws IllegalArgumentException {
139    assertConvertFromJdbcType(jdbcType, Boolean.class,
140                              EnumSet.of(BIT, BOOLEAN, INTEGER, SMALLINT, TINYINT));
141  }
142
143  /** {@inheritDoc } */
144  @Override
145  public void cleanField() {
146    setSelected(false);
147  }
148
149  private Hook hook;
150
151  /** {@inheritDoc } */
152  @Override
153  public final Hook getSsComponentHook() {
154    if (hook == null)
155      hook = new Hook(this) {
156        /**
157         * Updates the value stored and displayed in the SwingSet component
158         * based on getColumnText()
159         */
160        @Override
161        protected void updateSsComponent() {
162          logger.log(Level.DEBUG,
163                     () -> sf("%s: getColumnText() - %s", getColumnForLog(), getColumnText()));
164
165          Boolean value = getColumnObject(Boolean.class);
166          setSelected(value == null ? false : value);
167        }
168
169        /** {@inheritDoc } */
170        @Override
171        protected CheckBoxListener getSsComponentListener() {
172          return new CheckBoxListener();
173        }
174
175        /** {@inheritDoc } */
176        @Override
177        protected void addSsComponentListener(EventListener eventListener) {
178          addItemListener((ItemListener) eventListener);
179        }
180
181        /** {@inheritDoc } */
182        @Override
183        protected void removeSsComponentListener(EventListener eventListener) {
184          removeItemListener((ItemListener) eventListener);
185        }
186      };
187    return hook;
188  }
189
190  /** {@inheritDoc} */
191  @Override
192  public String toString() {
193    return sf("CheckBox{selected=%s, %s}", isSelected(), SsUtils.ssComponentToString(this));
194  }
195
196} // end public class SsCheckBox
